summary: Vizsla Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release about a working capital facility. A Mexican subsidiary secured an unsecured MXN$173 million (≈US$10 million) facility from FIFOMI, a Mexican government mining finance institution. Terms: five-year term, TIIE plus 4.6681% interest, two-year grace on principal, 1.0% commission. Proceeds support Panuco silver-gold project operating/working capital. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No change of control, strategic review, or capital return is involved. The filing is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer.
